from pathlib import Path
import shutil,subprocess,json
root=Path('/home/lloydk/work/gma-benchmark');base=Path('/tmp/gma-m4-review/mutants');results=[]
def run(name, file, mutate, args, marker):
 dest=base/name
 if dest.exists():shutil.rmtree(dest)
 for folder in ['src','tests']:shutil.copytree(root/folder,dest/folder)
 for f in ['package.json','bench.js','benchmark-workloads.js']:shutil.copy2(root/f,dest/f)
 (dest/'node_modules').symlink_to(root/'node_modules',target_is_directory=True)
 p=dest/file;before=p.read_text();after=mutate(before);assert before!=after;p.write_text(after)
 result=subprocess.run(['node',*args],cwd=dest,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=180)
 (base/f'{name}.log').write_text(result.stdout)
 assert result.returncode!=0 and marker in result.stdout,(name,result.returncode,result.stdout[-2000:])
 results.append({'mutation':name,'rejected':True,'exit':result.returncode,'assertion_marker':marker})
 print(name,'rejected',flush=True)
def shared(s):
 s='const sharedHueCache = new Float64Array(3601*13);\n'+s
 return s.replace('new Float64Array((360 * HUE_SCALE + 1) * HUE_STRIDE)','sharedHueCache')
run('shared-target-cache','src/oklch-cubic.js',shared,['--test','--test-name-pattern=target caches','tests/matrix-mappers.test.js'],'target caches')
run('plain-horner','src/matrix-solver-policy.js',lambda s:s.replace('let value = p[0], error = 0;','return ((p[0]*x+p[1])*x+p[2])*x+p[3];\n\tlet value = p[0], error = 0;'),['--test','--test-name-pattern=compensated fold','tests/matrix-mappers.test.js'],'compensated fold')
run('unbounded-fold','src/oklch-halley.js',lambda s:s.replace('q0, q1, q2, C)','q0, q1, q2)'),['--test','--test-name-pattern=fold-gap','tests/matrix-mappers.test.js'],'fold-gap')
run('wrong-timed-callback','bench.js',lambda s:s.replace('["oklch-halley", inGamutCheck ? oklchHalleyChecked : oklchHalley]','["oklch-halley", clip]'),['bench.js','--gamut','srgb','--validate-only'],'oklch-halley')
run('lost-child-gamut','bench.js',lambda s:s.replace('const args = ["--warmup", String(warmup), "--gamut", gamut];','const args = ["--warmup", String(warmup)];'),['--test','--test-name-pattern=forwards srgb','tests/bench-cli.test.js'],'CLI forwards srgb')
(base/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')

notes: Accuracy claims are corpus-specific. Fold-gap expectations are unclipped and enforce the authored Oklab line.
Focused/fold results are medians of two process medians; full-harness results are medians of two process averages from rendered Mitata output.
The fold workload measures 128 colors per case, at four lightnesses and 32 hues strictly inside each window; C=.01 (interior), .18 (mixed), .4 (exterior).
Capping the search also enables an early return for interior fold colors; fold speed changes cannot be attributed solely to allocation removal.
Rust performance was not measured in this JavaScript review follow-up.
